parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US: English

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type.

For more information about the resource types that are supported by Resource Center, see [Services that work with Resource Center](~~477798~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcecenter list-resource-types --accept-language zh-CN --resource-type ACS::ACK::Cluster --query ResourceType --region cn-hangzhou
